decision_summary: Approve the narrow three-entity Judge Consequence and Abstention Robustness design for implementation.
rationale: Visionary confirms the evaluator-trust gap, Builder reuses the calibration-report and same-evidence model, and Guardian requires six-way outcome separation, accountable abstention review, privacy, governance, non-authority, and anti-surveillance.
recommendation: Implement schema, verifier, example, fixtures, documentation, roadmap, and release evidence, then run full self-review and Council review.
